fusions.name: Flashover
fusions.desc: Looses 4 fireballs in a wide spread, each of which deals 10 damage, ignores resistances and sets its target [Burning] for 6 seconds. [Burning] is catching: it passes to up to 2 more enemies within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Backdraft
fusions.desc: Throws a gout of flame that deals 9 damage to the first enemy it meets, then bursts, hitting every enemy within 2.5 tiles for 80% of that. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Fanned Higher
fusions.desc: Increases your fire damage by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Nothing Left Unlit
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on enemies that are immune to them. You have 15% fire resistance.
